items.name: jingle/benchmark/1a
items.title: Level Zero (take A)
items.prompt: Over-produced commercial pop jingle, 8 seconds, 128 BPM in E major, glossy 2000s bubblegum synth-pop: sidechained synth chords, finger snaps, a big kick, sparkle risers. One cheerful male lead vocal drenched in hard, stepped, robotic pitch-correction, every note snapped to the scale, plus stacked harmonies on the last line. He sings exactly these words once, crisp and clear, starting on the downbeat: "Certified! Your graphics card is Level Zero, a Fixture! Nobody argues with a door!" Delivery: delighted, like a game-show host reading a government form he loves. End on a bright stab chord and a short reverb tail. No intro, no verse, no other lyrics.

items.name: jingle/benchmark/1b
items.title: Level Zero (take B)
items.prompt: Over-the-top radio jingle, 8 seconds, 132 BPM in F major, brassy jingle-house production: horn stabs, slap bass, handclaps, one snare crack. One cheerful male lead vocal with extreme robotic hard-tuned pitch-correction, warbling between notes, and a four-part backing choir answering him. He sings exactly these words once, crisp and clear, starting on the downbeat: "Certified! Your graphics card is Level Zero, a Fixture! Nobody argues with a door!" Delivery: proud and slightly too much, like a clerk who has been waiting all week to stamp something. End on a big final chord with slap-back echo. No intro, no verse, no other lyrics.

items.name: jingle/benchmark/2a
items.title: In Compliance (take A)
items.prompt: Over-produced commercial pop jingle, 8 seconds, 124 BPM in D major, glossy 2000s synth-pop: plucky synth arpeggio, claps, a big kick, a vocoder pad. One sunny male lead vocal drenched in hard, stepped, robotic pitch-correction, every note snapped to the scale, harmonies stacked on the last words. He sings exactly these words once, crisp and clear, starting on the downbeat: "You are not in trouble, you are in compliance! Every frame metered by intent: Article Seven!" Delivery: warm, reassuring, a little too bright, like a customer-service announcement set to music. End on a sustained stacked-vocal chord. No intro, no verse, no other lyrics.

items.name: jingle/benchmark/2b
items.title: In Compliance (take B)
items.prompt: Over-the-top boy-band jingle, 8 seconds, 120 BPM in G major, shiny late-1990s pop production: muted guitar, synth strings, a key change on the last line. One sweet male lead vocal with extreme robotic hard-tuned pitch-correction, plus a stacked harmony chorus. He sings exactly these words once, crisp and clear, starting on the downbeat: "You are not in trouble, you are in compliance! Every frame metered by intent: Article Seven!" Delivery: earnest and gleeful, as if compliance were a love song. End on a big held harmony and a cymbal swell. No intro, no verse, no other lyrics.

items.name: jingle/benchmark/3a
items.title: Same Form (take A)
items.prompt: Over-produced commercial pop jingle, 8 seconds, 130 BPM in A major, glossy 2000s electropop: bouncing synth bass, finger snaps, a laser riser, a big kick. One upbeat male lead vocal drenched in hard, stepped, robotic pitch-correction, every note snapped to the scale. He sings exactly these words once, crisp and clear, starting on the downbeat: "Custodian of Record: you! Envelope: sixty frames! License the card, license the mind, it's the same form!" Delivery: chipper and fast, like a clerk who finds the paperwork thrilling. End on a bright stab and a short reverb tail. No intro, no verse, no other lyrics.

items.name: jingle/benchmark/3b
items.title: Same Form (take B)
items.prompt: Over-the-top radio jingle, 8 seconds, 126 BPM in B-flat major, brassy 1980s jingle-house production with a modern hard-tuned vocal: horn stabs, gated snare, synth bass. One upbeat male lead vocal with extreme robotic pitch-correction warble, answered by a small backing choir on the last line. He sings exactly these words once, crisp and clear, starting on the downbeat: "Custodian of Record: you! Envelope: sixty frames! License the card, license the mind, it's the same form!" Delivery: delighted, as if reading the small print were a party. End on a big final chord with slap-back echo. No intro, no verse, no other lyrics.
